title: Molecular design of electrolyte additives for high-voltage fast-charging lithium metal batteries
content:
Energy Environ. Sci., 2025, 18,1464-1476
DOI: 10.1039/D4EE04282D, Paper
Yu Ou, Wenhui Hou, Da Zhu, Changjian Li, Pan Zhou, Xuan Song, Yingchun Xia, Yang Lu, Shuaishuai Yan, Hangyu Zhou, Qingbin Cao, Haiyu Zhou, Hao Liu, Xiao Ma, Zhi Liu, Hong Xu, Kai Liu
In our study, we introduce vinyl sulfonyl fluoride (VSF), a bifunctional electrolyte additive designed to stabilize both the SEI and CEI under extreme conditions.
